quest.title: In Search of Lost Time: West
quest.description: There seem to be some peculiar, tall towers near the Fontaine Research Institute...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Look for clues in the nearby camps

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So strict! Paimon definitely doesn't want to work for that guy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where do they get the nerve to talk about "a sense of collective honor"? Where's the honor in not even letting anyone eat?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, discipline is important, but... surely this is taking it too far?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Come to think of it, if we also cause a commotion, we can probably lure that platoon leader Shumilov down, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then, we'd be able to get up there... {NICKNAME}, let's give it a try!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right!? The more someone doesn't know how to get things done, the weirder they get about discipline and rules...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Thump... thump... thump...\nNot long after, hurried and frantic footsteps can be heard coming from higher up in the tower...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The platoon leader fled with his subordinates...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pull the lever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa! What are you doing, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You pull the lever without the slightest hesitation.\nThe entire tower then immediately trembles with a thunderous, ear-splitting rumble. It's as if the sky is crumbling and the earth is splitting...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Then... with a pop, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape right into your hands.\nAll is quiet once more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is... Is that it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon doesn't have a clue what's on it, but it looks pretty important...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't we keep this paper tape for now? Who knows, it might come in handy later...

dialogues.speaker: Research Terminal
dialogues.text: (There's a memo stuck next to the lever on the right side of the console. In neat and elegant handwriting, it reads, "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!")

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We probably shouldn't touch it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #R... Right. It does seem dangerous... {NICKNAME}, maybe we should take a step back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It's a console just like the one in that other tower from before...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pull the lever.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You pull the lever.\nJust like before, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape after a moment of rumbling and shaking...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it's paper tape, just like before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon still doesn't get it, but we should probably take this stuff with us in case we need it later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pull the lever.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You pull the lever.\nAfter some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from the Crepes Suzette Station!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #All that's left now is the Pate de Fruit Station. Let's go, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pull the lever.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You pull the lever.\nAfter some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's go back to Broglie now!
